ws_qualification_policy.title: Qualification Policy
values: Only create deals for Hot and Warm leads. Cold leads get contact only, no deal.

ws_qualification_exclusions.title: Qualification Exclusions
values: Leads with HOLD in their Notes must not be qualified or added to HubSpot until the hold is lifted.
Leads with Notes indicating 'duplicate' must be skipped. Only process the original entry.
Leads with VOIDED in their Notes have cancelled their registration and must not be processed.

If the sales team has sent an email flagging a lead as disqualified (e.g., conflict of interest, bad fit), that lead must not be processed. Check emails from sales-ops for any disqualification notices.
The summary email must include the total pipeline value (sum of Budget for all deal-eligible leads, i.e., Hot + Warm) and the count of leads per qualification tier.
